bio: The owners of this restaurant set up shop in this spruce brick building in the pedestrianised zone in 2011 and have been working with great dedication ever since, maintaining the highest culinary standards. A genuine feel-good atmosphere reigns in the elegant yet cosy dining rooms; their tasteful decor exudes Frisian charm. René Dittrich cooks up classic dishes, the quality of the ingredients, the craftsmanship and wonderful flavours of which never fail to impress. Your hostess is Daniela Dittrich, who is in charge of the well-trained and attentive front-of-house team, who work together seamlessly to cater to diners' every need. Should you wish to savour this delightful spot near the sea a little longer, be sure to book one of the two very pretty holiday apartments....
